summary: Field-by-field release policy for the UMich 2021 treadmill signals, with exact author and Vicon evidence plus a bounded marker/kinetic probe (4 random recordings, seed 20261028, plus the AB02/i5 lead and 2 anomaly recordings; an independent verifier reproduced it on 5 disjoint recordings, seed 4242). Canonical: pelvis tilt, hip flexion and knee flexion (Vicon text: PSIS above ASIS positive; authors: flexion and dorsiflexion positive; pelvis matches marker tilt with median error within 0.1 deg in all 10 trials of both samples). Derived estimate: hip/knee velocities. Source-only: powers (source power has the opposite sign of internal moment x joint speed in 60 of 60 joint-sides; slope -0.71 to -1.02), joint forces, non-sagittal components, foot progression, and force plates (newtons and millimetres, vs README N/kg and metres; walking direction flips between trials). The current pelvis + hip thigh/shank values are wrong by about twice the pelvic tilt against markers; the author hip - pelvis recipe tracks them. They are withheld in every option. Two decisions are open: thigh/shank release form, and whether ankle angle and sagittal moments become canonical. The AB07 incline-10 right ankle run and the AB08 level left excursion (screen-dependent: 9 frames at 45 deg, 8 at 60, 2 at 90) stay source-only and unshifted; canonical ankle stays missing for both whole recording-sides. The coordinator lead (AB02/i5 hip never in extension) is explained by Plug-in Gait hip being relative to an anteriorly tilted pelvis (mean tilt 18.8 deg). It is not a sign error, and it supports hip - pelvis.

It read markers, angles, sagittal moments/powers and the right plate for AB08/i5, AB08/d10, AB09/i5, AB10/d5 (random) and AB02/i5 (lead), plus AnkleAngles for AB07/i10 and AB08/i0. Moment sign and power slope were checked for 3 joints x 2 sides x 5 trials. The force-plate unit/axis was checked on the right plate in 5 trials. With the verifier, 10 of 50 recordings.
Condition naming: README p.2 states Streaming d5 = 5 deg decline and i5 = incline; p.5 states Normalized 'in' = downhill. The aliases d5/d10 -> in5/in10 are therefore source-documented.

decisions.question: How should UMich 2021 treadmill thigh and shank angles be released?
decisions.why: The authors publish hip minus pelvis as their thigh estimate, and leg markers agree within about 8 degrees across two independent samples (10 of 10 legs closer than the current recipe in each). It is still a planar sum of 3D angles, and the shank step (minus knee) is ours, so a labeled estimate is more honest than the standard names.

options.label: Leave out thigh and shank
options.consequence: No segment columns until a 3D model reconstruction exists; nothing to correct later. Reversible.

options.label: Labeled planar estimate (hip - pelvis, hip - pelvis - knee)
options.consequence: Separately named estimate columns with formula provenance; standard names stay missing. Reversible.

options.label: Standard thigh/shank names from the same recipe
options.consequence: Users get standard columns that are planar approximations; first requires a written LocoHub segment-angle sign rule (reference section). Reversible, but outward-facing once released.

decisions.check: review_sheets/D-UM21-C01-1/index.html: one random stride, marker thigh/shank vs both recipes.
decisions.cost_of_waiting: Thigh/shank stay missing in the first treadmill release; nothing else waits.

decisions.question: Should UMich 2021 treadmill ankle angle and hip/knee/ankle flexion moments become standard columns (moments only after the LocoHub moment sign rule is written)?
decisions.why: The authors state dorsiflexion/flexion positive and internal moments, Vicon puts flexion first for every joint and side, and the ankle stance moment sign agrees in every sampled leg (hip/knee signs rest on the authors). Any adopted moment column first needs a written LocoHub internal/external moment sign section in the reference. The ankle zero carries unpublished static offsets, and anomalous ankle recording-sides stay missing in every option.

options.label: Neither yet
options.consequence: Wait for author replies; the first release has no ankle angle or moments as standard columns. Reversible.

options.label: Flexion moments only
options.consequence: Three sagittal moments become standard, unchanged from source, once the LocoHub moment sign rule is written; the ankle angle waits on its zero offset. Reversible.

options.label: Ankle angle and flexion moments
options.consequence: Four signals become standard, unchanged from source, once the LocoHub moment sign rule is written; anomalous ankle recording-sides stay missing. Reversible.
